description: This is a Swagger/OpenAPI JSON specification defining API endpoints related to IP interface management within a network device or system. It includes operations for adding, listing, retrieving, deleting, and resetting statistics for IP interfaces, along with detailed response schemas and request payloads.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.Add
methods.description: Adds a new IP Interface with specified configuration.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IP Interfaces with optional pagination.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified IP Interface by ID.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves detailed status and configuration parameters for a specific IP Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistical counters of a specified IP Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies configuration parameters of a specific IP Interface.
